```{r}
# PCA
endo<-RunPCA(endo,features=VariableFeatures(object=endo))

ElbowPlot(endo) +  ggtitle("Elbow plot") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), axis.title.x=element_text(size=11), axis.title.y =element_text(size=11), axis.text.x = element_text(size=8), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8))


# clustering 

endo<-FindNeighbors(endo, dims=1:15)
endo<-FindClusters(endo, resolution=0.5)


# UMAP

set.seed(123)
endo<-RunUMAP(endo,dims=1:15)
UMAP <- DimPlot(endo, reduction="umap", label=TRUE,  pt.size = 0.5) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
  ggtitle("UMAP") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), axis.title.x=element_text(size=11), axis.title.y =element_text(size=11), axis.text.x = element_text(size=8), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)) +  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")) +
  labs(colour="Cluster")


# markers

endo.markers<-FindAllMarkers(endo, logfc.threshold=0.25, test.use="roc", only.pos=FALSE)

top3_markers <- endo.markers %>%
   group_by(cluster) %>%
   slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  ungroup()

dp_markers <- c("LGR5", "VWF", "PTPRC", "CDHR3", "PDGFRB", "F13A1", "TOP2A", "SUFU", "PLCL1", "SFRP4")

# dotplot

dp_markers <- intersect(dp_markers, rownames(endo))
dot_plot <- DotPlot(endo, features = dp_markers) +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 5)) + 
  RotatedAxis() + 
  ylab("Cluster") + xlab("Feature") + 
  ggtitle("Biomarkers Dot plot") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), axis.title.x=element_text(size=11), axis.title.y =element_text(size=11), axis.text.x = element_text(size=8), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)) +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))

# heatmap

umap_cols <- ggplot_build(UMAP)$data[[1]] %>%
  dplyr::select(colour, group) %>%
  distinct()

cluster_cols <- setNames(
  umap_cols$colour,
  levels(Idents(endo))
)

heatmap_cluster_cols <- c("0"="#F8766D", "1"="#E18A00", "2"="#BE9C00", "5"="#00BE70", "4"="#24B700", "3"="#8CAB00", "6"="#00C1AB", "7-12"="#8B93FF")

endo$cluster_original <- Idents(endo)

endo$cluster_grouped <- as.character(endo$cluster_original)

endo$cluster_grouped[endo$cluster_grouped %in% c("7","8","9","10","11","12")] <- "7-12"

endo$cluster_grouped <- factor(
  endo$cluster_grouped,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7-12")
)

Idents(endo) <- "cluster_grouped"

endo <- subset(endo, cells = colnames(endo)[!is.na(Idents(endo))])

Idents(endo) <- droplevels(Idents(endo))

final_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(endo, features = unique(top3_markers$gene), group.colors=heatmap_cluster_cols) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size=7.5), axis.title.y = element_text(size=10), axis.title.x = element_text(size=10), axis.title.x.top = element_text(size=10)) +
  ggtitle("Top 3 markers Heatmap") +
  labs(x="Cluster", y="Feature") +
  theme(
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")) +
  guides(colour="none")

Idents(endo) <- "cluster_original"


# internal annotation

hpca <- HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData()
monaco <- MonacoImmuneData()

pred_hpca <- SingleR(
  test = GetAssayData(endo, slot = "data"),
  ref = hpca,
  labels = hpca$label.main
)

pred_mono <- SingleR(
  test = GetAssayData(endo, slot = "data"),
  ref = monaco,
  labels = monaco$label.main
)

endo$SingleR_HPCA_cell <- pred_hpca$labels
endo$SingleR_Monaco_cell <- pred_mono$labels

endo$seurat_clusters <- as.character(endo$seurat_clusters)

cluster_labels_hpca <- endo@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(
    HPCA_label = names(which.max(table(SingleR_HPCA_cell)))
  )

endo$SingleR_HPCA <- cluster_labels_hpca$HPCA_label[
  match(endo$seurat_clusters, cluster_labels_hpca$seurat_clusters)
]

cluster_labels_mono <- endo@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(
    Monaco_label = names(which.max(table(SingleR_Monaco_cell)))
  )

endo$SingleR_Monaco <- cluster_labels_mono$Monaco_label[
  match(endo$seurat_clusters, cluster_labels_mono$seurat_clusters)
]
```
